Q6144.reason: Under Miller and Jenkins, obscenity requires patently offensive sexual conduct; mere nonsexual nudity is constitutionally protected and cannot be banned as obscene.

Q6146.reason: The Sixth Amendment right to counsel attaches only at critical stages after adversary proceedings begin; investigative surveillance is not such a stage, unlike preliminary hearings, arraignment, and post-charge lineups.

Q6151.reason: Glycogen phosphorylase cleaves glycogen with inorganic phosphate, so the first product is glucose-1-phosphate, later converted to glucose-6-phosphate.
